body.faq_description: Common questions about ecommerce platforms, headless commerce, payments, timelines and ongoing support.

faqs.question: What ecommerce platforms do you build on?
faqs.answer: We work with Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce and custom headless storefronts using Next.js connected to commerce APIs such as Shopify Storefront, BigCommerce and commercetools. Platform choice depends on your catalogue size, customisation needs, integrations and growth plans.

faqs.question: Shopify vs BigCommerce: which is right for my business?
faqs.answer: Shopify excels for fast setup, a strong app ecosystem and smaller-to-mid catalogues. BigCommerce suits larger catalogues, B2B features and headless commerce flexibility. We assess your product count, integration needs and growth plans to recommend the right platform, or a headless approach for maximum performance and design freedom.

faqs.question: What is headless ecommerce?
faqs.answer: Headless ecommerce separates the storefront (what customers see) from the commerce backend (products, cart, checkout). This lets us build fast, custom front ends with Next.js while using proven platforms for inventory, payments and order management. It is ideal when performance, design freedom and integrations matter.

faqs.question: Can you migrate my existing online store?
faqs.answer: Yes. We migrate stores from WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento, legacy Shopify themes and custom builds to modern platforms or headless architectures. We plan URL redirects, preserve SEO equity where possible and improve page speed and checkout as part of the migration.

faqs.question: Do you integrate payment gateways?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and regional gateways required for your markets. Checkout flows are scoped for security, mobile usability and conversion, with testing across devices before launch.

faqs.question: How long does ecommerce development take?
faqs.answer: A focused Shopify or WooCommerce store often takes 3-6 weeks depending on catalogue size, design scope and integrations. Headless builds and larger catalogues typically take 6-10 weeks. We provide a realistic timeline after discovery based on features, content readiness and third-party integrations.

faqs.question: Do you build multilingual ecommerce stores?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build multilingual storefronts with localised product content, currency support and SEO-friendly URL structures. This helps retailers serve global audiences and diverse local markets from a single commerce stack.

faqs.question: Do you provide maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing support covering security updates, platform upgrades, performance monitoring, catalogue changes and conversion improvements. Support can be scoped as ad-hoc hours or a monthly retainer with agreed response times.

faqs.question: Do you build ecommerce stores for the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build UAE ecommerce with local payment gateways, bilingual catalogues and COD-friendly checkout. See our UAE ecommerce development page for regional projects.
